# The CLAUDE.md block

Habits and SOPs are useless if nothing knows they are there. One generated block in
the user-level prompt (default `~/CLAUDE.md`, `--target` for another) fixes that. It
is the only edit this plugin makes outside `~/.claude-user-data/`.

`habits.py install` writes it. Never hand-edit it. Edit the habit or SOP files and
reinstall.

## Shape (index mode)

```markdown
<!-- agent-habits:begin -->
<!-- Generated by Agent-Habits on <date> from ~/.claude-user-data. ... -->

## Habits

Standing habits, in force before the task is known. Each line is the rule. The
full text, with exceptions and rationale, is `~/.claude-user-data/habits/<id>.md`. ...

- **<title>** (`<id>`): <summary>

These apply only when their trigger does:

- *When <trigger>:* **<title>** (`<id>`): <summary>

## Procedures

Recurring procedures (SOPs) live in `~/.claude-user-data/sops/`. Before improvising
a multi-step job, check whether one matches below; ...

- When <trigger>: `<id>`

<!-- agent-habits:end -->
```

Each habit costs one summary line and each SOP one trigger line. The full texts cost
nothing until read. `check context` holds the block to 7,000 characters. If it goes
over, give habits triggers, or merge or retire some. Don't raise the budget.

## Rules the installer follows

- **Idempotent.** It replaces the content between the markers and never appends a
  second block.
- **Each marker exactly once.** If either marker appears zero times while the other
  is present, or appears twice, the installer stops. The file has been hand-edited,
  so show the user rather than guessing.
- **Legacy blocks** (`habits-of-claude:*` from Habits-Of-Claude, `claude-sops:*`
  from the old SOP plugin) are converted. The first one becomes the new block and
  any others are removed.
- **Back up first.** `--write` copies the file to `<file>.bak-<timestamp>`.
- **Dry run by default.** Show the diff and ask before `--write`, because this file
  governs every future session.
- **Placement.** A new block is appended at the end. After that the installer keeps
  it wherever the user moves it.

## Wording

The procedures paragraph says *check whether one matches before improvising*, not
*always read the index*. The second becomes a chore attached to every session and
gets ignored within a week. Keep any local rewording on the same side of that line.
